subject: How to stop an instance when user exits app.

messages.author: 0aec13b78c3f1b81
messages.subject: How to stop an instance when user exits app.
parts:
Hi I have deployed a public app on shinyapps.io

After testing the app and closing the browser tab, I realized that on the dashboard the app's instance is still running and the application usage meter counting.
I have to manually stop the instance even though nobody is accessing the app.
Is there a way to automatically stop the app instance when a user exits the app by closing the browser or browser tab?

Thank you!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to stop an instance when user exits app.
parts: By default, application instances should automatically stop after being idle for 15 minutes. You can adjust this by setting the "Instance Idle Timeout" setting in the dashboard.
